name: LedgerBridge - hybrid on-premises + AWS settlement platform
description: On-premises ledger and batch processing connected to an AWS extension through a single site-to-site VPN, with partner integration, archiving and reporting; seeded network-boundary, dependency-failure, data-movement, compliance and operational-support concerns.

revision.title: Hardening revision 1
revision.change_notes: Reporting database listener restricted to the VPN CIDR and database encrypted with Multi-AZ enabled; partner bucket made private; gateway role scoped to specific resources; partner API key moved to SSM secure parameter; dead-letter queue and log retention added.
